facts.fact: The IPDCP, led by its President Colonel Belei Bediani, was at work on 18 November 2026, according to its own release.

The IPDCP trained correspondents on the legal framework from June 2026, assessed them on 30 September and 1 October, and certified the first 28 on 18 November 2026, drawn from banks, insurers, telecom operators, port bodies, local authorities and digital firms.

note: No law named; no ruling stated.
